digest.component_or_area: Rebar plan-review, Jira reconciliation, CLI routing, code-review policy, binding store
propositions: Five recovered approved-but-lossy RP decisions (RP-02 through RP-06) require evidence-backed research briefs before becoming implementation stories to preserve architectural intent and resolve implementation-critical ambiguities.

RP-02 establishes ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary with tombstone/forward/reverse identity overlap validation, distinct from general multi-file or Jira ACID atomicity claims.

RP-03 implements singular retry ownership with maximum 3 physical wire invocations per atomic logical operation, 15 seconds cumulative inline sleep, and a scoped finite-pass fuse opening after 3 consecutive exhausted provider-suspect outcomes across at least 2 tickets.

RP-04 centralizes operation-authority composition with explicit CLI > environment > project > user > default precedence, per-operation snapshot, separate secret boundary, and removal of legacy Cloud adapter fallbacks.

RP-05 and RP-06 require both stdlib-immutable lazy CLI registry with pre-operation help routing and unified effective-policy discovery for review gates with typed failure handling, content-identical checkpoint reuse, and explicit --retry override semantics.
